        ### Question

Go to your health center (located 3 hours from the nearest hospital) for fever of 39 º C, pain in the wound and malaise. opb. Clean the wound and administer intramuscular nonspecific gammaglobulin.
opc. Give 400 mg of oral moxifloxacin and send to the hospital.
opd. Give clindamycin 600 mg orally every 8 hours and observation.
